options.markdown:
Usage


Charts below the header refer to the usage of Azure OpenAI service.

chart.name: Total Token usage
chart.programText:
A = data('ProcessedPromptTokens', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled'), extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('GeneratedTokens', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled'), extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='B', enable=False)
D = (A+B).publish(label='D')

options.markdown:
Usage


Charts below the header refer to the usage of Azure OpenAI model.

Performance


Charts below the header refer to the invocation performance of Azure OpenAI model.

chart.name: Top Invocations by Latency overview by model
chart.programText:
A = data('AzureOpenAITTLTInMS', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled'), rollup='average', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).mean(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).mean(by=['modeldeploymentname']).top(count=10).publish(label='A')
B = data('AzureOpenAITTLTInMS', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled'), rollup='max', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).max(by=['modeldeploymentname']).top(count=10).publish(label='B')
C = data('AzureOpenAITTLTInMS', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled'), rollup='min', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).min(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).min(by=['modeldeploymentname']).top(count=10).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Average tokens per request
chart.programText:
A = data('ProcessedPromptTokens', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled'), extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('GeneratedTokens', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled'), extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['modelversion']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('AzureOpenAIRequests', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled'), extrapolation='zero').dimensions(renames={"ModelDeploymentName": "modeldeploymentname"}).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum().top(10).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = ((A+B)/C).publish(label='D')

chart.name: Average Invocation Latency
chart.programText:
A = data('AzureOpenAITTLTInMS', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled')).publish(label='A')
B = data('AzureOpenAINormalizedTTFTInMS', filter=filter('azure_subscription_state', 'enabled', 'Enabled')).publish(label='B')
